summary: MIND CTI filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CEO Ariel Glassner and the appointment of founder Monica Iancu as Interim CEO effective July 1, 2026, and Orly Sorokin as Chief Business Officer. The board thanked Glassner but disclosed no terms, price, premium, or advisors. This is a forced/abrupt departure of the CEO, constituting a special-situation management change. No financial deal terms, break fee, or regulatory clock are present. Watch for potential strategic shifts under the returning founder and any future M&A or restructuring announcements.
